fit.why: anode and screen current fitted together with Philips sheet A (Vg2 250 / 375 / 425 V, the screen voltages of the ultralinear stages) and the Mullard triode-connected curves (Ia + Ig2 down to low Va); AS from Reefman eq. 27 with alpha = 0 (Reefman: not a fitting parameter, a very small reduction; the data fit alpha 0 and 0.74 equally well, rms 1.71 / 1.12 mA screen, 4.57 / 4.51 mA triode connected, but alpha 0.74 doubles the 5-20 distortion); residuals below 30 mA weigh 3 times

equations: D. Reefman, Spice models for vacuum tubes using the uTracer (2019), sec. 4.4, eq. 15, 16, 23, 25 - 27 (anode and screen current, AS from eq. 27; implemented from the equations, parameters fitted to verify/data/tubes)
